description: Grants the loopback dashboard origin (window main only) the core IPC defaults and the app commands it calls: request_notification_permission (wizard), and for the in-app login open_signin_window, close_signin_window (the card's Cancel) and webview_ready (the page has its listeners; kept sign-in events are sent again), and apply_update (Restart to update / Update now: the shell backs up, checks and installs a staged update). The notification plugin's own commands are deliberately NOT granted here: the page never calls them, notify.rs posts every banner from Rust (where plugin permissions do not apply), and granting notification:default to a remote origin would let any script on port 8647 post a detailed banner behind the generic-while-locked rule. The sign-in window is in no capability, so the sign-in page can call nothing.
